findings.title: No substitute can occupy the place of the divine words

findings.mechanism: The focus carrier names the written book, received revelation, and discrete words while the replacement agent is denied; 18:29 declares the truth from the Lord and 18:44 locates true guardianship with Allah, so the pericope supplies an independent authority contact for the focus prohibition.
findings.reader_payoff: The prohibition becomes a claim about the irreplaceable source and authority of the words, not only a warning about editing their surface form.
findings.containment: This finding concerns the focus's source and authority relation; it does not claim that the pericope settles every question about interpretation or human response.
